# RehabLookup

> RehabLookup is a free directory of addiction treatment facility listings across
> the United States (all 50 states and Washington, D.C.). Most listings come from
> SAMHSA's FindTreatment.gov directory and reflect information facilities report
> to SAMHSA; RehabLookup has not independently verified them. Facilities can claim
> and update their listings. RehabLookup is not a treatment provider, does not
> place people in treatment, and does not verify insurance. In an emergency call
> 911; for a mental health or substance use crisis call or text 988; for free,
> confidential treatment referral information call SAMHSA's National Helpline at
> 1-800-662-4357.

## Find treatment
- [Directory home](https://rehablookup.com/): Search facility listings by location, level of care, and payment type
- [Browse by state](https://rehablookup.com/locations): State and city directory pages
- [Example state directory](https://rehablookup.com/rehab-centers/california): Listings in one state
